Luke Daniel

A collection of personal and academic projects I have developed.

Projects

Visualizing Industrial Impact in Allegheny County

A data analytics capstone project for GASP (Group Against Smog & Pollution) visualizing 5 years of air quality violations and fines from major industrial polluters.

NY Sports Attendance Predictor

An interactive Machine Learning tool predicting home game attendance for major NY-area sports teams based on weather, form, and rivalries.

AMC Guide

A web application with a custom scraper and React frontend for filtering and organizing AMC movie showtimes.

NFL Uniform Mixer

An interactive static web app to visualize and customize matchups between NFL teams.
